objects.description: During the [FunnyDream](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0007) campaign, the [FunnyDream](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1044) backdoor was used to execute multiple components and exfiltrate files.(Citation: Bitdefender FunnyDream Campaign November 2020)
objects.description_fa: در طول کمپین [FunnyDream](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0007)، از درپشتی [FunnyDream](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1044) برای اجرای چندین مؤلفه و استخراج فایل‌ها استفاده شد.(Citation: Bitdefender FunnyDream Campaign November 2020)
